title: Skills need the right weapon
changes: Bow skills (Volley, Power Shot, Fire Arrows...) need a bow in hand, blade skills (Lunging Strike, Cleave, Blade Flurry...) need a sword, katana or axe, and Shield Wall needs a shield.
Skills you can't use with your current weapon are crossed out on the skill bar. Spells, shouts, traps and auras work with any weapon.
